notes:
Church plant meeting in a school (Wilson K-8, 2330 W Glover Rd, Oro Valley) on Sundays at 10am. Affiliation confirmed 2026-09-10: the 'What We Believe' page uses the EFCA Statement of Faith and the church appears in the EFCA church directory, so tradition was changed from non_denominational to evangelical_free.

Staff page (hopetucson.com/staff) lists four pastoral staff: Randy Brainard (Lead Pastor & Elder), Kevin Mason (Family Pastor & Elder), Gary Jones (Discipleship Pastor), Christian Kah (Worship Pastor), plus a lay elder board (Eric Abrams, Doug Gotcher, Scott Haffner, Dan Larkin, Scott Munro, Chad Schwarz, Rudy Stadelman, Steve Williamson). Only Randy Brainard is recorded here as a preaching pastor because his is the only name with a sermon-speaker archive page on the church site (hopetucson.com/media/speaker/Pastor+Randy+Brainard). The site exposes no speaker index page, so if Mason or Jones also take the pulpit that should be picked up from sermon titles/descriptions when transcripts are fetched - add them then rather than guessing now.

YouTube channel confirmed as the church's own (channel ID UCK5Qx9f2Q9F3HEoT35STlVQ; the channel description names Wilson K-8). Only two sermon playlists were exposed in the sermons page HTML (Wisdom, Luke); the page shows about nine series tiles, so more playlists probably sit behind JavaScript. Distinct from Hope Church (Assemblies of God) on Houghton Rd. Coordinates cleared so tools/geocode.py re-runs on the confirmed street address.
